# Börsstrateg: Det här har småspararna köpt

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-09-08  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Avanza's Elin and commentator Ulf discuss retail flows. Retail investors are net sellers of stocks overall but keep buying dips and taking profits on winners such as Nibe, Evolution and the banks. Bank and welfare stocks are being sold ahead of a close election, with AcadeMedia the most exposed to a red-green win. Avanza's 'superinvestors' are buying beaten-down US megacaps like Nvidia. The 52-week-low list points to possible turnarounds in operating companies such as New Wave, Fenix Outdoor, Volvo Car and Green Landscaping, while real estate stays out of favour as long rates rise.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Retail investors are net buying again after the report and the dip; Ulf frames it as a good company expected to keep rising.

#### Reasoning

Ulf describes retail investors buying the Clas Ohlson dip, calling it a good company that will keep going up, and says buying the dip has mostly worked since 2020. This describes what customers believe more than a firm call from the hosts, so it is a watch rather than a buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the next report shows weaker sales or margins
- if a broad market decline breaks the buy-the-dip pattern

> *"Clas Ohlsson föll lite grann här. Det är ett bra bolag och kommer fortsätta upp."*

---

### ⛔ ACAD — AcadeMedia | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Schools are the sector most exposed to a red-green election win; the effect would be very large for AcadeMedia.

#### Reasoning

Ulf names schools as the welfare sector most exposed to the election, which is roughly 50-50. Retail investors are already net selling welfare stocks to cut that risk. He notes the red-green side may not agree well enough to push changes through, but says the effect would be very large for AcadeMedia if they did.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the right-leaning bloc wins the election
- if red-green parties drop plans to regulate or tax school companies

> *"på marginalen skulle det ske så är det stor, stor effekt framförallt för Academedia"*

---

### 🟠 NEWA-B — New Wave | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Large, stable company with a capable CEO, trading near its 52-week low after a poorly received report; a possible turnaround pick.

#### Reasoning

Elin lists New Wave among operating companies at 52-week lows where expectations may have been cleared out and an operational turnaround could change the narrative. Ulf agrees that buying near support can be a strategy as good as any. It requires patience, and timing the bottom is hard.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the fade continues below the 52-week low
- if the next report confirms weakening operations

> *"New Wave på högersidan som vi ser som ett stort, stabilt bolag med en stor, stabil, duktig vd"*

---

### 🟠 FOI-B — Fenix Outdoor | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down 75% from the peak after unexpectedly weak reports, but a well-known company with strong products; turnaround candidate.

#### Reasoning

Elin puts Fenix Outdoor on the 52-week-low list as a possible turnaround. Ulf understands why it has been sold down after unexpectedly weak reports but stresses the strong products and the 75% drop from the top. It is speculative until the reports improve.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the next report is weak again
- if margins keep eroding

> *"den har tappat 75 % från toppen trots att det är ett välkänt bolag med starka produkter"*

---

### 🟠 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Car | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

At its 52-week low; Elin sees possible operational-turnaround candidates on this list.

#### Reasoning

Elin names Volvo Car among operating companies at 52-week lows where expectations may already be cleared and a turnaround could shift the narrative. She says it looks interesting but gives no company-specific thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if there are no signs of an operational turnaround in upcoming reports

> *"Därför har vi Phoenix Outdoor, Volvo Car, Green Landscaping, New Wave och en hel del andra bolag. Det tycker jag ser spännande ut."*

---

### 🟠 GREEN — Green Landscaping | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

At its 52-week low; named as a possible turnaround candidate.

#### Reasoning

Elin includes Green Landscaping in the same list of 52-week-low operating companies that could turn around. It is a general screen with no company-specific thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if there are no signs of an operational turnaround in upcoming reports

> *"Därför har vi Phoenix Outdoor, Volvo Car, Green Landscaping, New Wave och en hel del andra bolag. Det tycker jag ser spännande ut."*

---

### 🟠 MYCR — Mycronic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Rose sharply on its report and then lost the whole gain; Ulf says such post-report fades can become bargain situations.

#### Reasoning

Ulf tracks stocks that jumped on strong reports and then gave back all of the gain even though the information did not change. He names Mycronic as one example and calls such cases possible bargains that investors should stay alert to.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new information shows the fundamentals have deteriorated

> *"Nobia och Mycronic var ett par bolag som steg kraftigt på rapporterna och sedan har tappat hela uppgången."*

---

### 🟠 NOBI — Nobia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Rose sharply on its report and has since given back the whole gain; a possible post-report bargain.

#### Reasoning

Ulf names Nobia alongside Mycronic as a stock that lost its whole report-day gain. He frames these as possible bargains but gives no fundamental view on Nobia.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the fade reflects deteriorating fundamentals rather than sentiment

> *"Nobia och Mycronic var ett par bolag som steg kraftigt på rapporterna och sedan har tappat hela uppgången."*

---

### 🟠 KLAR — Klarna | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Stabilised at $14-15 after trading near $20; Ulf thinks it could well be turning.

#### Reasoning

Ulf says Klarna has been a poor holding depending on the entry point, but it has stabilised around $14-15 and he thinks it could well be turning. Superinvestors appear to have been buying it. This is speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the price breaks below the $14 support

> *"Nu har den stabiliserats på 14 dollar eller 15 dollar. Men det var inte länge sedan den stod i 20. Det kan mycket väl vara en vändning."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Superinvestors are net buying the lagging megacap while the broad customer base sells.

#### Reasoning

This comes from customer statistics, not a host call. Superinvestors, who beat the Stockholm exchange with lower risk, are dip-buying established tech such as Nvidia that has lagged recently, while the broad customer base is a heavy net seller.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US big tech keeps underperforming

> *"vi hittar Nvidia på köplistan. Nvidia är storsåld bland gemene avanzian."*
